summary: Join our specialized training on cross-border financial crime and asset recovery. Equip yourself with essential skills to tackle global financial challenges.
lede: Cross-border financial crime involves illicit funds moving through transactions and structures across jurisdictions. Designed for compliance, risk, audit, and investigative professionals, the course covers spotting transaction red flags, tracing assets, and building clear case files. It also explores coordination with relevant authorities and ways to support asset recovery within legal frameworks and institutional policies.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly face financial crime risk, compliance decisions, or investigative responsibilities.
audience: Compliance officers and risk managers in banks
Internal auditors and fraud risk officers
Financial intelligence unit (FIU) analysts and investigators
Law enforcement and investigation unit staff
modules: Typologies and Red Flags in Cross-Border Transactions
Legal and Regulatory Frameworks for Asset Recovery
Tracing Assets and Following the Money
Collaboration with Regulators and Law Enforcement
Emerging Channels: Digital Payments, Crypto, and Fintech
Practical Roadmap for Strengthening Financial Crime and Asset Recovery Capacity
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial crime principles and experience in risk management, compliance, or related fields. Prior exposure to cross-border financial operations is beneficial but not required.
